rationale: The two findings caused by/adjacent to this task's changes are verified resolved against current source: CR-002's href-item onClick now guards the menu-close call with `!item.disabled` (NavigationMore.tsx), so a disabled href item no longer closes the popover or navigates when clicked. CR-003's kebab trigger now computes `hasMenuContent` (children present, or at least one non-divider item visible) and disables the trigger button when it is false, so a row with zero visible actions no longer opens an empty popover. Both fixes are covered by 5 new tests in NavigationMore.test.tsx (27/27 passing) plus the full consumer suite (493 passing, no regressions). CR-001 and CR-004 through CR-008 are explicitly deferred: the user scoped this follow-up to CR-002/CR-003 only, since CR-001 is a commit-format issue on an older, already-existing commit and CR-004-CR-008 are pre-existing findings in ChatSidebar/ChatListItemContextMenu/focusedChatSidebarViewModel unrelated to this task's two plan tasks.

standards_review.notes: CR-001 (commit-format) is deferred out of scope for this follow-up; see finding_status.

No security-relevant surface touched by this fix-up.

finding_status.notes: onClick for href-based items now short-circuits with preventDefault + stopPropagation when `item.disabled`, so it neither navigates nor triggers `handleClickInside`'s unconditional menu close. Confirmed by the new disabled-href-item test in NavigationMore.test.tsx.

Trigger button gets `disabled={!hasMenuContent}` and `useClick(context, { enabled: hasMenuContent })`, where `hasMenuContent` is true only if `children` is passed or at least one non-divider item is visible. Confirmed by 4 new tests covering hidden-items, empty-items, one-visible-item, and children-only cases.
